_comment: Pre-registered before any extraction run. Failure analysis for prompt v2 may only read documents in 'analysis'; 'holdout' documents are never inspected during prompt iteration and serve as a small generalization check. Holdout is stratified: it contains clean docs (eob_03, eob_08, eob_18) and messy docs (eob_14 odd labels and unsigned amounts, eob_19 prose date and buried denial codes).
